headline: Sensex Rises 333 Points as Market Snaps Two-Day Losing Streak
why: Market snapped a two-day falling streak with broad-based recovery
Strong performance in Metals and FMCG sectors boosted indices
Global market anticipation ahead of the US Federal Reserve meeting
whatHappening: Sensex closed up 333 points while Nifty settled above 23,200 level
Bank of Japan raised interest rates to 1.25 percent, a 31-year high
Elevate Campuses set IPO price band for its 2,100 crore issue
Internal dispute emerged in Tata Group over N. Chandrasekaran's tenure extension

stocksInNews.sources: Tata Trusts calls Chairman Chandrasekaran's tenure extension illegal
Stock closed above Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP)
Management maps growth in nuclear, data centres, and hydrogen sectors
Signed three-year pact with Fiji firm for AI and IoT solutions

summary: Indian indices snapped a two-day losing streak as Sensex rose 333 points, led by gains in Metals and FMCG sectors. Meanwhile, Tata Group stocks face volatility following a legal dispute between Tata Trusts and the board over leadership tenure.
